extracted.intended_audience: Principal Investigators (PD/PIs) and Signing Officials (SO) who will initiate administrative supplement applications in ASSIST / eRA Commons
extracted.subtask_description: Step-by-step procedural guidance for initiating an Administrative Supplement application using the ASSIST system (including when initiated from eRA Commons), covering required fields, prepopulation options, valid formats, and submission-viewing behavior.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow application guide and NOFO/NOSI instructions
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants should follow instructions in the application guide, as well as the Notice of Funding Opportunity (NOFO) and/or Notice of Special Interest (NOSI) for any additional submission instructions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a required precept: read both the ASSIST application guide and the specific NOFO/NOSI because those documents may contain additional or differing instructions for the administrative supplement submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Who may initiate the administrative supplement
rubrics_metrics.description: In ASSIST, both the PI (any PD/PI) and the SO can initiate administrative supplements and use the prepopulate features if their organization ID matches the organization ID on the parent grant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Initiation and prepopulation privileges depend on organization ID matching the parent grant. Ensure your organization ID matches to use prepopulate features.

rubrics_metrics.name: Administrative supplement initiation from eRA Commons
rubrics_metrics.description: Administrative supplement requests can also be initiated, although not filled out or submitted, from the eRA Commons Administrative Supplement module. If initiated from eRA Commons, the administrative supplement has the parent grant number prepopulated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When started in eRA Commons you are redirected to ASSIST with the Parent Grant (federal ID) filled in; note that you cannot complete or submit the application inside eRA Commons—it must be done in ASSIST.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enter an Administrative Supplement (opportunity) number
rubrics_metrics.description: Log into ASSIST and enter an Administrative Supplement number. Click the Go button. The Initiate Administrative Supplement Application screen displays. At this point, the opportunity number that you entered on the previous screen is non-editable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose the correct opportunity number carefully because once entered and you proceed, it becomes non-editable on the Initiate screen.

rubrics_metrics.name: Parent Grant federal ID optional but required for prepopulation
rubrics_metrics.description: Optionally, enter the federal ID of the awarded grant (Parent Grant), and ASSIST will use information on the parent award to pre-populate specific data fields on the administrative supplement application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you do not enter a parent grant federal ID the forms will not be pre-populated. When initiated from eRA Commons, the Parent Grant (federal ID) field is filled in based on the grant you were working on and cannot be changed.

rubrics_metrics.name: NOSI format requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: A Notice of Special Interest (NOSI) is not required but, if one is entered, the format needs to be valid.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Notice of Special Interest reference must be in the form NOT-XX-XX-XXX, e.g. NOT-CA-19-001. Enter nothing if no NOSI applies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unique Supplement Label requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Enter a title or descriptor in the Unique Supplement Label field. This label is for your own purposes so that you can readily identify and search for the administrative supplement after it is initiated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use descriptive text that will help you search for and identify the application in progress at a later date; this label is user-facing and intended for easy retrieval.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project/Performance Site prepopulation checkbox behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: Project/Performance Site Location checkbox: If marked, ASSIST will pre-populate all of the sites from the Parent Grant into the Supplement Application 'Performance Site' form. If not marked, only the Primary Site from the Parent Grant will be pre-populated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mark this checkbox when you want all parent grant sites copied into the supplement; leave unchecked to bring over only the Primary Site.

rubrics_metrics.name: Senior/Key Persons prepopulation checkbox behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: Senior/Key Persons checkbox: If marked, ASSIST will pre-populate all Senior/Key persons from the Parent Grant into the Supplement Application 'Senior Key Persons' form. If not marked, only the Contact PD/PI will be pre-populated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this to copy the full senior/key personnel list from the parent grant or limit to the Contact PD/PI only.

rubrics_metrics.name: Attachments are not copied from parent grant
rubrics_metrics.description: Attachments such as specific aims, research strategy, and biosketches, for example, are not copied over since the opportunity or NOSI may request that specific information be added in these sections.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Plan to upload or prepare attachments specifically for the supplement application even if you pre-populate other fields from the parent grant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Federal ID validation and transition to ASSIST summary screen
rubrics_metrics.description: When you click Initiate Application, the federal ID will be validated and, if it exists, you will be taken to the ASSIST summary screen to complete the application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure the federal ID you enter is correct and existing; validation is performed immediately on initiation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multiple packages: select appropriate package
rubrics_metrics.description: If there are multiple packages associated with the funding opportunity, the available packages window opens before the ASSIST summary screen. Click the Select button for the appropriate package.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be sure to choose the correct package when multiple packages are offered for the opportunity; selection occurs prior to reaching the summary screen.

rubrics_metrics.name: Copy Application button limitation when initiated from eRA Commons
rubrics_metrics.description: While working in an administrative supplement application initiated from eRA Commons, the Copy Application button is not available from the left side navigation buttons.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you need to copy an application, do not initiate it from eRA Commons or be prepared to recreate needed content in ASSIST manually.

rubrics_metrics.name: Default two-day application viewing period and SO options
rubrics_metrics.description: By default, submitted applications have a two-day application viewing period, during which the SO can reject and revise an application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For non-competitive administrative supplements only, the SO can choose to skip the two-day viewing period and immediately release the application to Agency staff for processing; confirm SO preferences before submission.
